gallery.title: Abyssal Ascent
gallery.description: Hatch in the vent-lit cradle ten kilometres down and devour your way up through the depth zones, evolving as you go — and from your third form on, every body carries its own tap-to-use power. Every zone's residents fight back with ink, venom, voltage, and teeth, until you outgrow them and they become food; loyal little hangers-on will even join your wake and hunt at your side. Push far enough sideways and the water turns to ice. Become the Kraken and the fishing fleet becomes prey — and the fleet is nowhere near the last thing on the menu. Tilt your phone and the whole scene leans with you.
